source: can you create a game where it gives a creepy vibe and you suddenly wake up at 1am to your friend jasmine calling you and telling you to play the game 'flowers' so you agree and start bootting up the game after you end the call and you press start. A person named angel with a pastel flower crown,white oversized hoodie,short pink shirt,arm warmers and light purple socks on greets you in a flower field with a blue sky,fluffy clouds and soft music. its a pick your awnser game with 5 endings, good,bad,virus,stuck forever, and pulled into screen. you also do litte tasks like feed the kois in her beautiful koi pond and so on.

image_prompt.text: The moment of pressing start as a definite threshold between the bedroom and the flower field
The opening into the flower field placed so the blue sky, fluffy clouds and Angel are revealed in one shot
No route back to the bedroom once the game inside the game has started
A dim bedroom at 1am with a bed and a ringing phone, lit to feel wrong
An open flower field under a blue sky with fluffy clouds
A beautiful koi pond with koi swimming in it
Angel, a character in a pastel flower crown, white oversized hoodie, short pink shirt, arm warmers and light purple socks, standing in the field

layout_placement.text: A spot at the pond where the player feeds the koi
Points where the player picks an answer, branching toward five endings

notes: Two chapters that cannot co-exist on one surface - a bedroom and a flower field - hence P4; the bedroom is an interior, hence P3.
Two of the five endings, stuck forever and pulled into the screen, may need their own spaces; the prompt does not say.

open_questions.ask: How much of the bedroom is built - the whole room, or just the bit you see from the bed?
Do the five endings each need their own place, or do they all play out in the flower field?

theme: Soft pastel flower field framed by a creepy 1am bedroom

coverage_missing.ask: Do the bad, virus, stuck-forever and pulled-into-screen endings each get their own scene?
How large is the flower field - a clearing around the pond, or a landscape?
Should the creepy framing bleed into the flower field, or stay bright until an ending turns?

answers.ask: How much of the bedroom is built - the whole room, or just the bit you see from the bed?
answers.answer: Just the portion visible from the bed; keep the opening bedroom scene small and focused on waking up and Jasmine's call.

answers.ask: Do the five endings each need their own place, or do they all play out in the flower field?
answers.answer: Have all five endings play out in the flower field, with the ending presentation changing there rather than building separate areas.
